landing.heroBadge: 24/7 VN Stock Market Realtime Risk Management & Portfolio Platform
landing.heroDesc: Direct async feed connections to HOSE, HNX, and UPCoM with sub-second latency. Automated Take-Profit & Stop-Loss tracking for every individual investor.
landing.featureSectionDesc: Engineered specifically for the Vietnamese stock market with maximum performance and resilience.
landing.feat1Desc: Direct async I/O connection to HOSE, HNX, and UPCoM exchange APIs. Zero browser overhead, sub-second responses.
landing.feat2Desc: Realtime PnL computation with instant Take-Profit & Stop-Loss notifications delivered directly to your personal Telegram with spam cooldown protection.
landing.feat3Desc: Automated technical screening for Volume Breakout, RSI oversold rebound, and MA20 crossover entry opportunities.
landing.feat4Desc: Complete isolation of portfolios, custom TP/SL thresholds, and API keys secured by Bcrypt password hashing and JWT access tokens.
landing.feat5Desc: Smart session detection for Morning (09:00 - 11:30), Lunch break (11:30 - 13:00), and Afternoon (13:00 - 15:00) in Vietnam timezone (UTC+7).
landing.feat6Desc: Composite indexed time-series storage providing detailed interactive price and volume charts for in-depth analysis.
